verseText: The LORD will give strength unto his people; the LORD will bless his people with peace.
intro: September is here! Open your Bible, learn God's Word, get moving, and complete this month's three Bible Adventure missions. New coloring and activity pages are coming this month!

read.title: Open Your Bible
read.text: Find Psalm 29:11. Read it out loud with somebody in your family. What two gifts does the LORD give His people?

move.title: Strong & Steady
move.text: Stand tall and strong for 10 seconds, take 3 slow peaceful breaths, then say: The LORD gives strength and peace!

learn.title: Bible Challenge
learn.question: According to Psalm 29:11, what will the LORD give His people and what will He bless them with?
